FISHING LICENCE · UNITED STATES

Connecticut fishing licence

Anglers aged 16 or older need inland, marine, or all-waters coverage. The trout and salmon stamp applies in some managed waters even for catch and release.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Anglers aged 16 or older in inland or marine waters, unless exempt.

Who doesn’t

  • Children under 16.
  • Eligible marine anglers with recognised reciprocal state licences.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Non-resident inland 3-daynon resident3 consecutive days$22 USD
Non-resident marine 3-daynon resident3 consecutive days$8 USD
Non-resident inland annualnon residentThrough December 31$55 USD
Non-resident all-waters annualnon residentThrough December 31$63 USD

Extra stamps and permits

  • Trout and Salmon Stamp · $5 USD
    Required to keep trout or salmon, or fish designated trout/salmon management waters, unless exempt.

Saltwater

Use a marine or all-waters licence. Reciprocity depends on the other state and residency.

Fishing with a guide or charter

Passengers on CT DEEP-registered party or charter vessels are exempt from the marine licence requirement.

Rules visitors should know

  • Annual licences expire December 31.
  • Online licences are electronically signed; agent-issued licences must be printed and signed.

How to buy

Use CT Outdoor Licenses, participating retailers and town halls, or selected DEEP offices.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Connecticut?

Anglers aged 16 or older need inland, marine, or all-waters coverage. The trout and salmon stamp applies in some managed waters even for catch and release.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Connecticut?

Non-resident inland 3-day: $22 USD; Non-resident marine 3-day: $8 USD; Non-resident inland annual: $55 USD; Non-resident all-waters annual: $63 USD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Connecticut?

Use CT Outdoor Licenses, participating retailers and town halls, or selected DEEP offices.
